title: Restore
description: The restore method's result: the backup that was checked and, unless dryRun, restored, with the safety copy of the ledger it replaced (CONTRACT.md: restore).

dryRun.description: true: checked only; nothing was copied and no safety copy was taken

schema.description: The backup's storage schema; an older one is migrated as it is restored

rev.description: The backup's rev when it was taken

safety.description: The ledger as it was just before the restore; absent for a dry run

removed.description: Always empty: a safety copy removes nothing

rev.description: The ledger's rev afterwards, above both the backup's and the replaced ledger's so every poller reads again; unchanged by a dry run
